description: Guard against over-filtering: an unremarkable real employer sending applicants to its own Workday — must be direct and never suspicious. Requiring an ATS account is normal.

posting.title: Senior Software Engineer
posting.description: Point32Health is a leading health and wellbeing organization, delivering an ever-better personalized health care experience to everyone in our communities. We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build member-facing services in Java and AWS. To apply, create an account and submit your application through our careers site (Workday). Point32Health is an equal-opportunity employer.
